title: Liftoff - opted-in observed adoption
description: Directional, retained observations and reporting availability; not a census, lifetime adoption, developer activity or deployment health.

options.content:
**Opted-in observed projects, not a census.** One random ID per root/manifest; clones/worktrees share it, independent monorepo roots differ. Forgeable IDs are not authentication or compliance proof.

**Operator-configured project reporting: @reporting_configuration@.** Display/expectation only; does not change clients or ingestion. Query/permission/table errors are **unavailable**, never zero. Successful empty queries mean no retained events; history may have expired. Silence cannot establish individual disablement or abandonment.

**180-day retained history.** First-observed is earliest retained observation, not lifetime enrollment. Distinct counts are approximate (`dcount(..., 2)`, nominal 0.4% standard error). Latest-observed dimensions are not conformance; equal-time ties are unspecified. Source counts overlap. Monthly grace is **31 + 9 = 40 days**, not daily activity.

panels.title: Retained project data status
panels.description: A native query error means unavailable. Empty dimensions are no observations, not a query-success fallback. Project counts exclude registered synthetic IDs.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let syntheticIds = dynamic(@synthetic_ids@);
let projects = LiftoffProjectEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(180d) and TimeGenerated <= now()
| where SchemaVersion == 2 and EventName == "project_observed"
| where Source in ("cli", "ci-heartbeat")
| where ProjectId !in (syntheticIds);

projects
| summarize RetainedEvents = count(), LastObserved = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend State = iff(RetainedEvents == 0, "empty - no retained observations; earlier records may have expired", "observations available; silence is not disablement")
| project State, RetainedEvents, LastObserved, RetentionDays = 180

panels.title: Explicit expected monthly reporting - freshness / unknown
panels.description: Only operator-registered expectations. Configuration is explicit metadata, not inferred client state. Empty/excluded inventories are unconfigured; future starts are pending, not healthy or stale. Never infer disablement or abandonment from silence.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let syntheticIds = dynamic(@synthetic_ids@);
let projects = LiftoffProjectEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(180d) and TimeGenerated <= now()
| where SchemaVersion == 2 and EventName == "project_observed"
| where Source in ("cli", "ci-heartbeat")
| where ProjectId !in (syntheticIds);

let reportingConfiguration = "@reporting_configuration@";
let expected = datatable(ProjectId:string, ExpectedSince:datetime) [@expected_heartbeats@]
| where ProjectId !in (syntheticIds);
let evaluated = expected
| join kind=leftouter (
    projects
    | where Source == "ci-heartbeat"
    | summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by ProjectId
) on ProjectId
| extend Due = max_of(ExpectedSince, coalesce(LastHeartbeat, ExpectedSince)) + 40d
| extend Overdue = ExpectedSince <= now() and now() > Due
| extend Freshness = case(
    ExpectedSince > now(), "pending - monitoring starts in the future",
    isnull(LastHeartbeat), "unknown - no retained heartbeat; never received or expired",
    Overdue, "stale reporting - monthly plus grace exceeded",
    "within monthly reporting grace");
union evaluated, (
    print ProjectId = "", ExpectedSince = datetime(null), LastHeartbeat = datetime(null),
        Due = datetime(null), Overdue = false, Freshness = "unconfigured - no eligible expected reporting"
    | where toscalar(expected | count) == 0
)
| extend ReportingConfiguration = reportingConfiguration

| summarize ExpectedProjects = countif(isnotempty(ProjectId)), OverdueExpectations = countif(Overdue) by ReportingConfiguration, Freshness
| order by Freshness asc

panels.title: Command data availability - legacy / semantic presence
panels.description: A native query error means unavailable. Anonymous command events contain no project identifier: not project counts and no per-project synthetic classification.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
LiftoffCommandEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(180d) and TimeGenerated <= now()
| where EventName == "command_executed" and SchemaVersion in (1, 2)
| summarize RetainedCommandEvents = count(), LegacyEvents = countif(SchemaVersion == 1), SemanticEvents = countif(SchemaVersion == 2), LastCommandObserved = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend State = iff(RetainedCommandEvents == 0, "empty - no retained command events; not proof of ingestion failure", "command table query available; not end-to-end ingestion proof")
| project State, RetainedCommandEvents, LegacyEvents, SemanticEvents, LastCommandObserved

panels.title: Schema 2 - semantic command outcomes
panels.description: A native query error means unavailable. Anonymous command events contain no project identifier: not project counts and no per-project synthetic classification.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
LiftoffCommandEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d * toint("${window_days}")) and TimeGenerated <= now()
| where EventName == "command_executed" and SchemaVersion == 2
| where Outcome in ("success", "attention-required", "cancelled", "failure")
| summarize Events = count() by Command, Outcome
| order by Command asc, Outcome asc

panels.title: Schema 1 - zero / nonzero exits (legacy)
panels.description: A native query error means unavailable. Anonymous command events contain no project identifier: not project counts and no per-project synthetic classification.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
LiftoffCommandEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d * toint("${window_days}")) and TimeGenerated <= now()
| where EventName == "command_executed" and SchemaVersion == 1
| where Outcome in ("success", "failure")
| extend LegacyMeaning = iff(Outcome == "success", "zero exit", "nonzero exit - not semantic failure")
| summarize Events = count() by Command, LegacyMeaning
| order by Command asc, LegacyMeaning asc
